question: Which goddesses are named as part of the group culminating in the eighth, Caṇḍikā?
premises: Caṇḍikā is named as the eighth.
inference: The group includes Vārāhī, Aindrī, Āmuṇḍā, and Caṇḍikā as the eighth.
uncertainties: The other members of the group are not listed in this verse.
plain_english: Vārāhī, likewise Aindrī, Āmuṇḍā, and Caṇḍikā as the eighth.
